message.reasoning: We need to fill the fuel tank. The tank holds up to 50 gallons. We currently have 10 liters. We need to convert liters to gallons. 1 liter ≈ 0.264172 gallons. So 10 liters ≈ 2.64172 gallons. To fill the tank to full capacity, we need to add 50 - 2.64172 = 47.35828 gallons. But the function expects fuelAmount in gallons. So we call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount ~47.36 gallons.
